historical_adaptations.marker: SCP-JP Wikidot skipos action-area pane: give the opened action-area pane the theme's own dark glass ground at every width so pane content stays readable over the page.
historical_adaptations.rationale: At the theme's container band crossings the opened action-area pane computes to a transparent background, so pane content renders over the bare page (defect Q1-29). The theme's own dark glass values (its --basalt-UI palette ground, also used by the footer) restore the pane ground. The W13 delta receipt measures the pane background rgba(0,0,0,0) without the block and rgba(25,25,39,0.686) with it at 499/500/501, 1079/1080/1081 and 1499/1500/1501 widths, with zero geometry change; the block is the W07-A session's prototype, adopted unchanged after this measurement.
